page.layout: One page of text: running head at top with page number left; ornamental rule; title heading in capitals; a short italic-set poem in stanzas with a large woodcut initial N at left; catchword "Auxi-" at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: CAROLVM EMANVELIS PHILIBERTI FILIVM SABAUDIAE Ducem à suscipiendo bello aduersus Geneuenses dehortatur.

page.notes: The initial N is a large woodcut ornamental letter, joined to the first word as "NE". Catchword "Auxi-" is at lower right. The first stanza's ornament and the stray marks at the page edges are not transcribed.
